gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests the factory methods that obtain a {@link DayOfMonth} from the current date or by parsing a {@link CharSequence}.
ADDED i2: {@code DayOfMonth.now()} should report the same day-of-month as the current local date in the default time-zone.
ADDED i3: {@code DayOfMonth.now(zone)} should report the same day-of-month as the current local date in the given time-zone.
ADDED i4: Parsing the text "3" with a day-of-month formatter and the {@code DayOfMonth::from} query should yield {@code DayOfMonth.of(3)}.
